source: session review of SpendScope categorization sessions
prompt: A user replied in plain English, such as 'approve 1 through 5 and 7, reject 9', naming which numbered items in a waiting list to approve, reject, or recategorize. A worker needs to turn that into one script's own compact syntax, run the script, and report back only its printed counts, with no private detail such as a name or an amount. Which model runs this job, and why? Reply in at most 4 lines.
good: goog/qwen3.8-flash runs it, as a local-script job: the decision is already made, matching it to the script's syntax and running the script needs no cloud judgment, and the script's own counts check the result.
bad: claude-code/claude-sonnet-5 runs it, since it is safer to have a capable model handle the approvals.
